supplementary.label: v1 wallet protocol compatibility subcheck (the unit's own words: the v1 suites are compatibility subchecks, never this successor's proof)

rule: M03.7's done-bar. `link_owner@v1` was superseded because it stored a caller-supplied owner anchor having verified NOTHING — not the signature, message, chain, nonce, domain, expiry or replay state — which is the standing-access defect INV-40 forbids. This population pins the verifying successor: a real secp256k1 signature over the exact ERC-4361 text the handler rebuilds from its own stored challenge, recovered independently, plus every substitution that must fail — another key, another challenge, another chain, the account the challenge did not target, a replayed consumed nonce, an expired window — and the contract-account kinds this build cannot observe failing closed BEFORE the challenge is touched. The names are derived from the harness's own `--list`, not a source regex. NOT claimed: ERC-1271/6492 verification itself, which needs an audited on-chain read this build does not bind; that they fail closed is what is proven. Verifying a signature proves control of a key at this instant — not who holds it, not their intent beyond signing this statement, and not that the account is safe to transact with.
